scope: Correct optional status-area functional proof to derive supported versus readable protected fallback from actual native Layout/Paint/geometry. No publication mechanism exception.
findings: Final caller Layout is single-line END ellipsized and retains at least six Unicode code points or its complete shorter identity. UTF16 suffix metrics, visible prefix, finite Paint width and compound padding are independently checked.
Capsule and caller bounds come from actual stable View/native AX screen geometry in the same focused native window. Missing, clipped, shifted, unfocused or unstable geometry rejects.

Minimum readable width is independently recomputed from the actual final capsule/caller widths, Paint prefix width, padding and root minimum. At fixed 480x854/240dpi/font1.3 the production 184dp root minimum is276px and protected lane is264px, so readable fallback is the only possible current native branch.
The retained generic supported branch is not claimed as native-tested. compatible_wide_native_lane explicitly remains NOT_TESTED_FIXED_480PX_VIEWPORT; existing 360dp host cases are separate evidence.

SystemUI identity comes from a unique exact target row of read-only native package registry output, cross-bound to native InputDispatcher window owner UID. Native title, token, TRUSTED_OVERLAY, input-channel and visibility checks remain strict.

Two equal current native StatusBar window/display-matrix/inset samples establish native window presence and geometry. Full-width top mapping, actual root visible status inset and nonoverlap with protected60dp clock/right icon zones are checked.
No new Accessibility icon resource IDs or guessed native icon availability prerequisites remain. proof_scope explicitly leaves actual icon visual presence to review of full real compositor captures.

All40 native method identities, legacy245 profiles, modern24 required filenames, Telecom/drag/cancel/hide/restore/opacity assertions and seven original verifier bytes remain unchanged. Production sources, host-test sources and .github have no diff from reviewed HEAD.

input_source_audit.semantics: Input pipeline uses display/server space; injected logical coordinates use display inverse. Native StatusBar frames map to logical capture coordinates by forward display matrix. Per-window transform and density guesses are not substitutes.
input_source_audit.precision: Matrix dump prints four decimal digits. Floor/ceil encloses the printed rectangle; it is not a general exact reconstruction of hidden nativefloat coefficients at arbitrary integer edges. Actual status-bottom uncertainty remains strictly between36 and37 and fixed fallback is separated below inset by12px.
